_comment: Every external input to the build, pinned. Natural Earth files are fetched from one fixed commit (the v5.1.2 tag) and checked against the git blob hash recorded in that commit's tree, so a changed file can never slip in. The font zip is checked against the SHA-256 digest GitHub publishes for the release asset.

naturalEarth.licence: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/)

pmtilesLicence._comment: The pmtiles npm package ships no LICENSE file; BSD-3 requires the notice to travel with the code, so it is taken from the upstream repo.

osmTss._comment: Snapshot of OpenStreetMap traffic-separation schemes around each strait, made by extract-osm-tss.mjs and committed. The build refuses a file whose checksum differs, so the drawn lanes only change on purpose.

osmCanals._comment: Snapshot of each canal's navigation line from OpenStreetMap, made by extract-osm-canals.mjs and committed. The build refuses a file whose checksum differs.

osmBorderLines._comment: Snapshot of the two border lines OpenStreetMap carries as geometry — the Northern Limit Line and the surviving Siegfried Line tank traps — made by extract-osm-border-lines.mjs and committed. The build refuses a file whose checksum differs, so what is drawn only changes on purpose. way/979904704 is excluded: it shares the NLL name but is the Han estuary neutral zone (left:country=Demarcation Zone).

osmPlaces._comment: Snapshot of the OpenStreetMap place nodes for headquarters towns too small for Natural Earth populated places, made by extract-osm-places.mjs and committed. Each is a place=* node found by name inside a tight bbox, never by bare name. The build refuses a file whose checksum differs.

resolveEcoregions._comment: RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017 release, used only by tools/extract-resolve.mjs; the build reads the committed extract.

codAbBangladesh._comment: OCHA Common Operational Dataset, Bangladesh administrative boundaries (source: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics), v03, valid on 2023-05-21; HDX resource last modified 2026-01-26. Divisions and districts, joined by pcode. HDX licence field: "Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)", http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/igo/legalcode — commercial use allowed with attribution.
codAbBangladesh.licence: CC BY-IGO 3.0 — Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics / OCHA

geoBoundariesIndia._comment: geoBoundaries gbOpen IND ADM2 (boundaryID IND-ADM2-76128533), year represented 2021, source "Pathways Data Pvt. Ltd., lgdirectory.gov.in", fixed at geoBoundaries commit 9469f09. osmBangladeshRivers._comment: The named major rivers of the Bangladesh basemap, from extract-bangladesh.mjs and committed; one exact-name selector per river inside its own box, the Brahmaputra family by way id. The build refuses a file whose checksum differs.

osmBangladeshLand._comment: Coastline land for the Bangladesh basemap, from extract-bangladesh.mjs and committed: OSM simplified land polygons for COVERAGE, full land polygons for the detail area. The upstream files are regenerated daily, so the files used are recorded inside the snapshot (date, size, sha256). The build refuses a file whose checksum differs.

treatyCities._comment: The Wikidata item and point of every city the environment-treaties seed names, each cited to the revision it was read at, from tools/extract-treaty-cities.mjs and committed. The build refuses a file whose checksum differs, so a marker only moves on purpose.

nasaBlueMarble._comment: The latitude-longitude globe's imagery, tiled by tools/build-latitude-longitude-imagery.mjs, which refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs. Equirectangular, the whole Earth, 5400 × 2700 px (8 km/pixel). The terms below are quoted from NASA's own pages, read 2026-09-27; each rule is what the map must do.
nasaBlueMarble.product: Blue Marble: Next Generation — July, with topography and bathymetry (world.topo.bathy.200407), 5400 × 2700
nasaBlueMarble.licence: NASA — free to re-use, commercial use included, no copyright indicated; credit "NASA Earth Observatory"

credit.rule: Credit "NASA Earth Observatory", in ⓘ, linked to the product's page.
credit.states: Anyone using or republishing Blue Marble: Next Generation please credit “NASA Earth Observatory.”

reuse.rule: Re-use is allowed, commercial use included; none of the product's pages indicates a copyright.
reuse.states: Most materials published under science.nasa.gov/earth, including images, are freely available for re-publication or re-use, including commercial purposes, except for where copyright is indicated.

endorsement.rule: No wording that suggests NASA endorses the map or the app.
endorsement.states: If the NASA material is to be used for commercial purposes, including advertisements, it must not explicitly or implicitly convey NASA’s endorsement of commercial goods or services.

logo.rule: No NASA logo, insignia or logotype.
logo.states: The use of the Insignia, Logotype and NASA identifiers is protected by law, and imagery is made available for use consistent with Media Usage Guidelines.

osmLiberationPoints._comment: The OpenStreetMap elements liberation-war-1971 takes where its sources give no point of the place itself (sector HQs, places, a grave), each matched by name inside its COD-AB upazila or district (or a box round the Indian district its source names), by type, id and version, from tools/extract-liberation-points.mjs. unclosOverview._comment: UN DOALOS, "Overview - Convention & Related Agreements": one of the two sources of the maritime-zones diagram (the user's decision, 2026-10-02). Fetched once with the repo's User-Agent into tools/.cache/unclos/; tools/verify.mjs finds every quote of data-sources/maritime-zones/maritime-zones.seed.json word for word in it, and holds the seed's pins to these.
unclosOverview.licence: The UN site's Terms of Use (https://www.un.org/en/about-us/terms-of-use, read 2026-10-01T22:43Z, page SHA-256 c63ab9e5…, kept in tools/.cache/unclos/) permit downloading and copying for personal, non-commercial use, without any right to redistribute or to create derivative works. So no UN text is committed: the seed holds the diagram's own Bengali sentences and, for each quote, only its place (file, offset, length) and SHA-256 (step 1c, 2026-10-02); the readable quotes stay in the gitignored cache.

unclosConvention._comment: The United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, full text as DOALOS publishes it, linked from the overview (closindx.htm, a frameset; parts listed in its contents frame): the other source of the maritime-zones diagram. Only the parts its seed cites. Fetched once with the repo's User-Agent into tools/.cache/unclos/.
unclosConvention.licence: The UN site's Terms of Use (https://www.un.org/en/about-us/terms-of-use, read 2026-10-01T22:43Z, page SHA-256 c63ab9e5…, kept in tools/.cache/unclos/) permit downloading and copying for personal, non-commercial use, without any right to redistribute or to create derivative works. threeR128._comment: Three.js r128, for the maritime-zones 3D view only (the user's approved exception, step 3, 2026-10-05; the shells' three stays 0.185.1): build/three.min.js and LICENSE from the npm package three 0.128.0, vendored unchanged in docs/visual/vendor/three-0.128.0/ and loaded only by docs/visual/zones3d.js, never from a CDN. The tarball was fetched once with the repo's User-Agent and pinned by that download (size, SHA-256; sha512 is the same bytes in npm's integrity form); tools/verify.mjs holds the vendored files to the SHA-256s below and pins their network surface.
threeR128.licence: MIT (the package's LICENSE, vendored beside the script)

bangladeshMaritime._comment: The bangladesh-maritime-boundary map's sources (work in progress, step 1, 2026-10-05), each fetched once with the repo's User-Agent into tools/.cache/bd-maritime/ and pinned by that download (size, SHA-256): the ITLOS judgment (Case No. 16), the PCA award with its hydrographer's appendix, S.R.O. No. 328 (2015) as deposited with the UN, Act No. XXIX of 2021 and the 1974 Act's sections it substitutes (bdlaws), Bangladesh's amended CLCS executive summary (2020), and India's and Myanmar's notes on the 2015 baselines. A PDF with a text layer also pins its text, as `pdftotext -enc UTF-8` (xpdf 4.06) prints it, under text/: the seed's quotes are offsets into that text. The PCA site (pca-cpa.org) answers our User-Agent with a Cloudflare challenge; the award is its own case repository's file. Terms: ITLOS's website terms bar reproduction and commercial use of its information or data and of its judgments without the Registrar's written permission; the user decided (2026-10-05) to proceed as with the UN (option ক): facts in our own words, our own drawing, no ITLOS text reproduced (notes/bangladesh-maritime-boundary.md). PCA's terms could not be read; bdlaws shows a copyright line and no terms; the UN copies fall under the UN Terms of Use already recorded for maritime-zones. Step 2 (2026-10-07): official sources only — the NCTB book is no longer pinned here; the Act's sections 3–5 and the Teknaf upazila page carry texts made by tools/lib/html-text.mjs; the two portal pages change ("changes": true), so a re-fetch that differs is reported, not cached.

orgMembers._comment: The org-members map’s sources (work in progress, step 1, 2026-10-06): each organisation’s own page (for G7 and G20 the presidency government’s), fetched once with the repo’s User-Agent into tools/.cache/org-members/sources/ and pinned by that download (size, SHA-256), with the text the seed’s quotes point into (tools/lib/html-text.mjs). Three pages were read in headless Edge with the same User-Agent (via "browser": asean.org and gcc-sg.org answer a plain fetch with a script challenge); fetch-sources.mjs does not download those. These pages change: a fresh download that differs is not cached, and the run says the seed’s re-check is due (notes/org-members.md). Terms: the seed’s terms table.
